description: This file contains the implementation of functions related to the state management of the Slap Sco Collection Object in the SLAP framework. Specifically, it includes the function SlapScoColReset to reset the object states. The file also contains licensing and copyright information, module description, and function documentation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoColReset(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Resets the state of the Slap Sco Collection Object by calling a standard reset function.
